news.title: Indore: IMC issues fire safety directives to building owners, commercial establishments
news.para: To enforce compliance, IMC is conducting a city-wide inspection drive. Property owners or operators found misusing basements or rooftops in violation of National Building Code (2016) Part-4 standards and prevailing building bylaws and safety standards will face formal notices and legal action.

news.title: Thiruvananthapuram: Housing project in limbo, families left waiting
news.para: The Thanal Housing Project in Muttathara remains stalled, affecting nearly one hundred families. Fresh technical and cost hurdles prevent the contractor from commencing much-needed construction work. This delay also holds up the relocation of slaughterhouses operating opposite the colony. Residents continue living in deteriorating houses while awaiting permanent housing solutions. The newly elected corporation council plans a detailed review to decide the project's future.

news.title: Competing claims over geotechnical report emerge in SNN Raj Etternia case in Bengaluru
news.para: Nagadi’s Sept 2022 geotechnical report states that according to information provided by the client, a portion of the project site was a former quarry that had been filled with soil, debris, and other material. The report adds that the investigation was carried out keeping these site conditions in mind.

news.title: Women property registrations jump 45% in Chhattisgarh after fee slash
news.para: A cut in registration fees for properties bought in women’s names has pushed their share of registered deeds from 32% to 41% in just under two months, according to state data. The jump is not just statistical.

news.title: Strata deploys ₹96 crore in residential projects in Chennai, Bengaluru
news.para: Strata has made structured credit investments of ₹96 crore across three RERA-approved residential developments in Chennai and Bengaluru. The transactions are structured targeting returns of about 16-17% per annum.

news.title: Income tax department detects TDS violations in Patna real estate projects
news.para: According to I-T officials, the survey focused on an under-construction project at Saguna Mor and revealed multiple lapses in TDS compliance. The firms allegedly failed to deduct TDS on payments related to services, purchase of goods, sale and purchase of immovable property, contractual work, development agreements and salaries, as required under the Income Tax Act.

news.title: Rajasthan to launch scheme to train 14 lakh construction workers, dependents
news.para: Jaipur's labour department will train fourteen lakh construction workers and their families.  The initiative will use ten percent of collected labour cess for skill development.  Workers will receive short-term construction job-oriented courses.  Dependants can pursue advanced training in emerging technology sectors.  This aims to boost employability and create new livelihood opportunities.

news.title: Indore civic body demolishes eight unsafe houses
news.para: Indore Municipal Corporation intensified its drive against unstable structures on Saturday. Eight vulnerable houses along Jeevan Rekha Marg were demolished by civic officials. These structures were built on loose soil mounds posing a risk of collapse. A city-wide survey is underway to identify more dangerous buildings across Indore. Action against unsafe buildings will continue to ensure public safety and aid development.

news.title: Government starts process to fill Odisha RERA bench vacancy
news.para: Odisha government has begun appointing a new member to the Real Estate Regulatory Authority. This appointment follows a previous member's early departure from the post. The chairperson's position in the Appellate Tribunal also remains vacant since May. Stakeholders worry these vacancies will slow dispute resolution for homebuyers and developers. Timely appointments are crucial for consumer protection and sector confidence.

news.title: Garhwa's deputy commissioner orders crackdown on illegal sand mining
news.para: Deputy Commissioner Pashupati Nath Mishra has ordered intensified action against illegal sand mining.  Strict vigil and regular raids will be conducted in specific blocks of Shri Banshidhar Nagar.  Officers must submit updated reports on illegal mining and actions taken.  Coordination between administrative and police officials will be stepped up.  The district administration reiterates its commitment to preventing illegal resource extraction.

news.title: After eight years of planning, PMRDA’s flagship TP schemes shift to Pune civic body
news.para: Pune Metropolitan Region Development Authority is transferring five town planning schemes to Pune Municipal Corporation. These schemes, including Mhalunge-Maan, were planned for eight years using land pooling. Landowners await promised roads and public amenities after years of waiting. The Pune Municipal Corporation will now oversee the implementation of these projects. Other proposed schemes along the Inner Ring Road face farmer opposition and await policy decisions.

news.title: Birla Corporation's profit down 3.2% to ₹115.7 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Birla Corporation's net profit declined 3.2 percent in the June quarter. Revenue from operations increased 7.8 percent, reaching Rs 2,646.45 crore. Cement sales volume grew five percent, but realization per ton saw a slight increase. The Jute division experienced a revenue drop of 16.7 percent. Cement demand is expected to recover after the monsoon season concludes.

news.title: Planned development of Gurugram among Haryana government's top priorities: CM
news.para: Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini reviewed Gurugram's development and civic issues. He directed officers to ensure proper disposal of construction and demolition waste. Basic amenities and power infrastructure were discussed for Wazirpur Enclave residents. Builders were warned against disconnecting electricity for unpaid maintenance charges. Saini mandated a one-month deadline to clear open dumping of construction waste.

news.title: DC orders closure of illegal homestays in Mysuru
news.para: Mysuru deputy commissioner ordered stringent safety measures for all homestays. Unregistered establishments must shut down immediately and obtain necessary approvals. Surprise inspections will verify safety protocols and guest record maintenance. Emergency contact numbers will be prominently displayed for tourist assistance. Tourists are advised to stay only in registered and licensed accommodations.

news.title: Prayagraj civic body to rollout OTS scheme for property tax defaulters from Aug 15
news.para: Prayagraj Municipal Corporation will launch a one-time settlement scheme for outstanding taxes. Property owners can clear pending dues in three installments after applying. The scheme benefits approximately 90,000 property owners, including long-term defaulters. This initiative aims to improve tax recovery and boost civic body revenue. The scheme will be available from August 15 to December 15.

news.title: Manesar civic body to map PGs & guesthouses built in residential zones
news.para: Gurugram municipality will recover property tax from unauthorized paying guests and guesthouses.  Officials will conduct surveys and seal properties if tax dues remain unpaid.  The corporation aims to recover Rs 229 crore from its top 100 defaulters.  Improving property tax collections is critical for civic infrastructure development projects.  The horticulture branch will also restore ponds and increase rainwater harvesting pits.

news.title: GCCs may lease 35-40 million sq ft office space annually over next two years: Report
news.para: Global capability centres have leased about 118 million sq ft of Grade-A office space across India’s top seven cities since 2021, accounting for 37% of overall office demand, according to Colliers India. GCCs leased 16.6 million sq ft in H1 2026, with Bengaluru and Hyderabad accounting for over 60% of demand.
